act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
text: Sexual harassment includes any one or more unwelcome acts or behaviour (directly or by implication) such as physical contact and advances, a demand or request for sexual favours, making sexually coloured remarks, showing pornography, or any other unwelcome physical, verbal or non-verbal conduct of sexual nature.
official_channel: Internal Committee (IC) / Local Committee (LC) / SHe-Box Portal (https://shebox.wcd.gov.in/)

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
text: Every employer of a workplace with 10 or more employees must constitute an Internal Committee (IC) by an order in writing. The Presiding Officer must be a woman employed at a senior level at the workplace, and at least one-half of the total members nominated must be women, including one external member from an NGO or association committed to the cause of women or familiar with sexual harassment issues.
official_channel: Employer HR / Internal Committee / SHe-Box Portal (https://shebox.wcd.gov.in/)

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
topic: Local Committee (LC) for Small Workplaces or Employer Complaints
text: The District Officer must constitute a Local Committee (LC) in every district to receive complaints of sexual harassment from establishments where an Internal Committee has not been constituted because the workplace has fewer than 10 workers, or where the complaint is against the employer himself.

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
topic: Time Limit for Filing a POSH Complaint
text: An aggrieved woman may make a complaint of sexual harassment at the workplace in writing to the Internal Committee or Local Committee within 3 months from the date of the incident (or the last incident in a series). The Committee may extend the time limit by up to another 3 months if it is satisfied that circumstances prevented the woman from filing within the initial 3 months, with reasons recorded in writing.
official_channel: Internal Committee (IC) / Local Committee (LC) / SHe-Box Portal (https://shebox.wcd.gov.in/)

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
text: The Internal Committee or Local Committee must complete its inquiry into a sexual harassment complaint within a period of 90 days. Both parties must be given an opportunity of being heard during the inquiry.

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
text: During the pendency of an inquiry, on a written request by the aggrieved woman, the Internal Committee or Local Committee may recommend to the employer to transfer the aggrieved woman or the respondent to another workplace, grant leave to the aggrieved woman up to a period of 3 months (in addition to regular leave), or grant other prescribed interim relief.

act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
text: The contents of the complaint, the identity and addresses of the aggrieved woman, respondent, and witnesses, any information relating to conciliation and inquiry proceedings, and recommendations of the Committee must not be published, communicated, or made known to the public, press, or media in any manner.

act_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD) — SHe-Box Portal
topic: How to File a Workplace Sexual Harassment Complaint Online (SHe-Box)
text: SHe-Box (Sexual Harassment electronic Box) is an official Government of India online portal maintained by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. Women working in both public and private sector organizations can register workplace sexual harassment complaints online, which are routed to the relevant Internal Committee or Local Committee for action and status tracking.

act_name: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended by Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017)
topic: Paid Maternity Leave Duration and Eligibility
text: A woman who has worked in an establishment for at least 80 days in the 12 months immediately preceding her expected date of delivery is entitled to paid maternity leave of up to 26 weeks for up to two surviving children (of which not more than 8 weeks may precede the expected delivery date). For a woman with two or more surviving children, the entitlement is 12 weeks. A woman adopting a child below 3 months of age or a commissioning mother is entitled to 12 weeks of maternity benefit.
official_channel: Employer HR / Ministry of Labour & Employment (https://labour.gov.in/)

act_name: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended by Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017)
topic: Work From Home After Maternity Leave
text: Where the nature of work assigned to a woman is such that she may work from home, the employer may allow her to do so after availing of the maternity benefit for such period and on such conditions as the employer and the woman may mutually agree.
official_channel: Employer HR / Ministry of Labour & Employment (https://labour.gov.in/)

act_name: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended by Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017)
text: Every establishment having 50 or more employees must have a creche facility within a prescribed distance, either separately or along with common facilities. The employer must allow a woman 4 visits a day to the creche, which includes the interval for rest allowed to her.
official_channel: Employer HR / Labour Inspector / Ministry of Labour & Employment (https://labour.gov.in/)

topic: Protection Against Dismissal During Pregnancy or Maternity Leave
text: When a woman absents herself from work in accordance with the provisions of the Maternity Benefit Act, it is unlawful for her employer to discharge or dismiss her during or on account of such absence, or to give notice of discharge or dismissal on such a day that the notice will expire during such absence, or to vary to her disadvantage any of the conditions of her service.
official_channel: Labour Commissioner / Ministry of Labour & Employment (https://labour.gov.in/)

topic: Consolidation of Maternity Benefits Under Social Security Code
text: Chapter VI of the Code on Social Security, 2020 subsumes and consolidates the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961, retaining core entitlements such as 26 weeks of paid maternity benefit (for up to two surviving children), 80-day work eligibility, creche facilities for establishments with 50 or more employees, and protection against dismissal during maternity absence. Users should verify current state-level enforcement notifications with the Ministry of Labour & Employment.

act_name: Equal Remuneration Act, 1976 / Code on Wages, 2019
topic: Equal Pay for Equal Work and Non-Discrimination in Recruitment
text: No employer shall discriminate among employees on the ground of gender in matters relating to wages in respect of the same work or work of a similar nature done by any employee. Employers are also prohibited from discriminating on the ground of gender while recruiting employees for the same work or work of a similar nature, except where employment of women in such work is prohibited or restricted by law.
official_channel: Labour Commissioner / Ministry of Labour & Employment (https://labour.gov.in/)
